name: cpbar_combustion_products
title: cpbar: mean specific heat of CmHn combustion products (function library)
summary: Three EES routines of the ULiege combustion library (cpbar, gamma, mmprod) returning the mean specific heat, the specific-heat ratio and the molar mass of the combustion products of a CmHn fuel in simplified air, between two temperatures, for complete combustion, incomplete combustion (with unburned-CO losses) or pure air.

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the companion test file CombCmHn_SI_PNG2003_V2_test.EES (TM-0254, EES 7.966): incomplete-combustion cpbar call (f = 0.07) and pure-air gamma/mmprod; independent Python/CoolProp ideal-gas re-computation for the complete-combustion, pure-air and f = 0.08 cases
verification.notes: All 7 EES values within 0.22 % (c_bar_p 0.22 %, gamma 0.07 %, Q_4/e 0.05 %, x 0.004 %, e_min exact); the other regimes within 0.12 % of an independent computation. Requires the CoolSolve fixes of branch fix/library-gaps; CoolSolve v0.3.0 gives wrong results.

related_external: CoolSolve examples/cpbar.eescode (CSX-013: earlier conversion of the same .LIB, same defects)
thermo_models CombCmHn_SI_PNG2003_V2_test.EES (TM-0254: companion EES test file, reference values)
